item.title: Updates: No trams Nottingham Station – Wilkinson St after power failure
item.description: Weather conditions are affecting trams after a power failure. 12 noon: Trams running to all stops with some wait times extended. NET said at 8:19 am Friday 9 January: ‘Due to a power failure, we have no service between Nottingham Station and Wilkinson Street.’ It is affecting both directions of the tram route.
